effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If this Tamer has 2 or fewer cards under it, you may place 1 Digimon card with ＜Save＞ in its text from your trash under this Tamer.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with ＜Save＞ in its text, by suspending this Tamer and placing 1 card from under one of your Tamers as the bottom digivolution card of that Digimon, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
